title: Nehemiah comes to Jerusalem
summary: Jones dates Nehemiah’s arrival in Jerusalem.
description: Jones dates Nehemiah’s arrival in Jerusalem. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed. The wall built and dedicated is a separate Appendix F line, on nehemiah-rebuilds-the-wall. That wall record keeps the sort for the building.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 454 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Not applied to nehemiah-rebuilds-the-wall. Nehemiah 2:11 is the arrival. The wall line is "Wall of Jerusalem built & dedicated".
